guard: Claude Code's batch notices count a role request held for its take, on activation and on the retry after a failed push, and a hook that takes and shows held requests pushes no notice for them
why: A held role request wakes the session but is not in peekInbox until its take is recorded. A batch
notice that lists peekInbox counts none of them and tells the agent 0 messages are waiting.
The suite imports MeshAgent from the built connector-core dist, so the command builds it
before each run and the agent.ts mutation rebuilds it after restore.

mutations.name: the batch notice lists only what a read can see
mutations.expectRed: 1b activation announces the held request as one message waiting
mutations.cell: 1b activation announces the held request as one message waiting
mutations.note: Activation counts none of the held requests and announces 0 messages waiting.

mutations.name: the retry after a failed push lists only what a read can see
mutations.replace: else if (owed() > 0) nudge(undefined, undefined, false, agent.peekInbox("automatic").filter((it) => !announced.has(it)));
mutations.expectRed: 2a the retry announces the held request the failed push missed
mutations.cell: 2a the retry announces the held request the failed push missed
mutations.note: The retry still fires, since owed counts the held request, but its notice lists nothing.

mutations.name: a take the hook waits on is announced as a new arrival
mutations.expectRed: 3b and its takes push no notice on top of it
mutations.cell: 3b and its takes push no notice on top of it
mutations.note: Each take the hook waits on reaches the wake policy as an arrival it has not announced, so it pushes a notice for a request the same hook frame is showing.

mutations.name: a frame chooses once, whatever its takes refused
mutations.expectRed: 4a the frame carries the second request in the room the cancelled one left
mutations.note: A refused take leaves its room empty, so the frame carries nothing a choosing again would have fit.
mutations.cell: 4a the frame carries the second request in the room the cancelled one left

mutations.name: a turn that lands during the take is added however long the frame gets
mutations.expectRed: 5b the frame shows the request its take recorded
mutations.note: The late turn is added beside messages already taken, the frame runs over the cap, and the cut frame drops the request the take recorded as shown.
mutations.cell: 5b the frame shows the request its take recorded

mutations.name: a held request counts toward a wake while its retry is waited out
mutations.expectRed: 6b the Stop after it pushes no notice, so no new turn starts
mutations.note: Stop counts the held request as waiting and pushes a notice, the notice starts a turn whose frame can take nothing, and the next Stop pushes again.
mutations.cell: 6b the Stop after it pushes no notice, so no new turn starts
